title: York Art Association

services.name: Our Exhibitions
services.desc: To enter works for upcoming exhibitions, please use the link below for complete prospectus information and registration details. The NANCY M WOODWARD GALLERY hosts seven exhibitions a year, including members-only exhibitions, invitationals, and the annual Open Juried Exhibition. Our gallery and hanging committees plan and oversee all of our exhibitions throughout the year. The SALLY LITTLE DANYO MEMBERS' SALES GALLERY, located at the front of the Nancy M. Woodward Gallery, (at the windows) and provides a venue for YAA members to display original artwork and prints that are for sale. If you would like to exhibit your art at the Members' Gallery, please continue to Request to Exhibit for more

blurb: Hello There! You've found your way to the York Art Association's Home Page. We are located in York, Pennsylvania and have been celebrating the visual arts in our community since 1905!
